messages:
mira: Heads up — customer C-8241 reporting repeated 503s for hosted inference since 09:04 UTC. Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/C-8241 :rotating_light:
sam: Oncall - looking. Are these 503s coming from api-gateway or upstream runner?
mira: Upstream runner crashes according to gateway logs. Customer says timeouts then immediate 503s. They sent a request example and model: `redwood/rw-large-v1`, batch=8.
jordan: I grabbed the runner logs from the node that handled the request: `2026-03-16T09:04:21Z runner[pid=4123] SIGSEGV at 0x7f8b2c14` and later `cudaErrorIllegalInstruction` followed by container Restarting. Short snippet:
```
[09:04:20] model_load: rw-large-v1 quant=fp16
[09:04:21] infer: kernel_launch failed: cudaErrorIllegalInstruction
[09:04:21] infer: aborting request, segmentation fault (SIGSEGV)
[09:04:22] watchdog: container exit code 139, restarting
```
kiara: Thanks. Node shows GPU memory spike right before crash: nvml reports 99% mem. There's also a prefetch job active (`kv_prefetch=true`).
kiara: Can you paste the exact curl the customer used? need headers, prompt size.
mira: They sent this (redacted): `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1","prompt":"<~2k tokens>","max_tokens":512,"batch_size":8}'`
jordan: Repro steps I ran locally on a small repro node: 1) load rw-large-v1 fp16 2) prime kv cache with long prefix 3) send 8 concurrent requests with ~2000 token prompt -> within ~20s GPU mem climbs then segfault.
jordan: Core dump at `/var/crash/runner_4123.core` and `dmesg` shows `oom-killer` style messages but not full host OOM. Possibly a cuda kernel assert / illegal instruction due to a bad kernel path for long KV cache + batch.
sam: Immediate mitigation: route traffic for this customer to fallback model smaller variant (rw-medium-v1) and disable batching for their customer route. Can we push a routing policy change now? @kiara
kiara: I can add a temporary route rule and set `max_batch_size=1` for that customer. Doing it now.
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-9921 — upstream-runner-crash-customer-impact (pager duty link)
kiara: Rule applied, customer route now to rw-medium-v1 single requests, confirm reduced errors?
mira: Customer confirms errors stopped after 2 mins. Good. :thumbsup:
jordan: Next steps for root cause: capture full nvprof / kernel logs, save core dump, and attempt repro with `--disable-prefetch` and `--kv-eviction=aggressive` to see if prefetch interacts with kernel path.
kiara: I enabled `collector` to snapshot `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and `nvml` at 1s. Also increased restart backoff so we don't hot-loop the container.
alex: From platform side, please try a canary build with a guard for kernel launch failures that falls back to a slower code path (disable a fused kernel). If that repros locally we can push a hotfix toggle.
jordan: Quick local test: repro succeeds with batch=8 + prefetch on fp16. When I set `--quantize int8` the crash does not reproduce (different kernel path). So kernel selection looks implicated.
sam: Ok plan: 1) Keep fallback routing for affected customers 2) Capture artifacts (core, nvprof, dmesg) and attach to PD-9921 3) Run kernel-path bisect on staging with long-prefix prompts + batch 8 4) If reproducible, roll a hotfix that disables fused kernel for rw-large-v1 until patched 5) Notify customers and close support ticket when stable.
mira: Noted and communicating to customer. I added status update to ticket and flagged for escalation.
jordan: I'll attach repro script and core to PD-9921. Repro command I used: `./repro.sh --model rw-large-v1 --batch 8 --prompt-size 2000 --kv-prefetch`
kiara: Any preference on keeping run logs retention? We should keep nvprof + core for 14 days at least.
alex: Keep for 30 days. Also add a guard in production to route requests that hit memory threshold >95% to a fallback variant automatically. We'll discuss in postmortem.
mira: Thanks team. Closing loop when PD-9921 has root cause and fix.
sam: Thx all — great coordination.
summary: Upstream inference runner (rw-large-v1, fp16) segfaulted under large prompts + batch=8 with prefetch active. Immediate mitigation: route customer to rw-medium-v1 with batching disabled. Artifacts captured and PD incident opened. Next: kernel-path bisect and hotfix to disable fused kernel if needed.
